defs.def: a particular way of doing sth, especially one in which you have to learn special skills 技巧；技艺；工艺

ex.s: Students should apply multiple learning techniques.
ex.t: 学生应运用多种学习技巧。

ex.s: Good shooting techniques.
ex.t: 不错的射击技巧

ex.s: However, the process can be made easier if you learn to practice three simple techniques.
ex.t: 然而，如果你学会运用三个简单技巧，这个过程会更容易。

ex.s: Even though this technique won't work for everyone, it helps many people get a good store of ideas to draw on.
ex.t: 尽管这技巧并非对每个人都有效，但它帮助许多人积累可用的好点子。

ex.s: The next technique is to write your draft rapidly without worrying about being perfect.
ex.t: 下一个技巧是快速写草稿，不必担心完美。

ex.s: First of all, lean the technique of nonstop writing.
ex.t: 首先，学习不间断写作的技巧。

ex.s: It's a technique that helps turn a long narrative into an interesting one.
ex.t: 这是一种把冗长叙述变成有趣故事的技巧。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
ex.t: 营员将彼此分享多彩的想法和想象，合作构思、速写并用非传统技法作画，创作出最酷的壁画，公开展示供所有人观看。

ex.s: For the past five years, Paula Smith, a historian of science, has devoted herself to re-creating long-forgotten techniques.
ex.t: 过去五年里，科学史学家葆拉·史密斯一直致力于重现那些被遗忘已久的技艺。

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，如今我在成长，曾经以为简单的世界变得复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能放下重担，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成了新角色。在这些世界里我可以是任何人的。我不必记下发生了什么，或作者写作时用了什么技巧。我读只是为了放松。

ex.s: Over the years, there have been a number of different techniques to help designers approach this important point.
ex.t: 多年来，出现了许多不同的技巧，帮助设计师处理这一要点。

ex.s: He asked the workers to use traditional techniques to make the bricks into walls, roofs and corridors.
ex.t: 他要求工人用传统工艺把砖砌成墙、屋顶和走廊。

defs.def: the skill with which sb is able to do sth practical 技术；技能

ex.s: So, after studying the techniques for a couple of years, he began offering them to pets.
ex.t: 于是，在钻研这些技术几年后，他开始把它们用于宠物。

ex.s: The latest ____56____ (engineer) techniques are applied to create this protective ____57____ (function) structure that is also beautiful.
ex.t: 最新____56____的技术被应用来创造这种同____57____样美丽的保护结构.

ex.s: If it’s short stories, Peter Mountford breaks down six techniques you can try to see which one helps you stick the landing.
ex.t: Peter Mountford打破了六种技术,

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究者用脑成像技术查看，当我们观看认为美的画作时，哪些脑区被激活。

ex.s: I found myself working with a robotics professor on techniques for collecting data from the desert remotely.
ex.t: 我发现自己与一位机器人学教授合作，研究从沙漠远程收集数据的技术。

ex.s: The researchers are so impressed that they suggest the elephant’s suction technique could help improve robotics technology.
ex.t: 研究人员印象如此深刻，以至于他们建议大象的吸力技术可能有助于改进机器人技术。

ex.s: Using air suction technique.
ex.t: 使用空气吸力技术。

ex.s: Working from an inspirational picture, this workshop at Helmsley Arts Centre will teach you the techniques you will need to recreate your picture in wool.
ex.t: 以一幅启发性的图画为参照，赫尔姆斯利艺术中心的这个工作坊将教你用羊毛重现图画所需的技术。

ex.s: In fact, anyone wishing to try race walking should probably first consult a coach or experienced racer to learn proper technique, she says.
ex.t: 她说，事实上，任何想尝试竞走的人可能都应先咨询教练或有经验的竞走者，以学习正确技术。

ex.s: The brain-training technique.
ex.t: 脑训练技术.

ex.s: Fingerprint scanning techniques develop fast.
ex.t: 指纹扫描技术发展迅速.

ex.s: The use of popular techniques.
ex.t: 流行技术的使用.

ex.s: CPR is a life-saving technique.
ex.t: 心肺复苏（CPR）是一项救命技术。

ex.s: Using such techniques, the opera had transformed a small stage into the whole universe.
ex.t: 利用这些技术,歌剧将一个小舞台变成了整个宇宙.

ex.s: These civilisations appeared at a similar time, and all developed advanced bronze-making techniques.
ex.t: 这些文明出现于一个相似的时间,都发展了先进的青铜制作技术.

ex.s: Rather, the slow food movement celebrates traditional food made with local ingredients and traditional cooking techniques.
ex.t: 相反,缓慢的食物运动颂扬用当地原料和传统烹饪技术制作的传统食物。

ex.s: Prior to modern food processing and storage techniques and the use of greenhouses, most food was essentially seasonal in nature.
ex.t: 在现代食品加工和储存技术以及温室使用之前,大多数食品基本上是季节性的.

ex.s: UNIT 5 FIRST AID 1 Listen to the conversation about first-aid techniques.
ex.t: UNIT 5 First AID 1 听关于急救技术的谈话.
